segments.text: 1 minute, 55 seconds Wall-E satirizes mass consumerism by depicting a planet destroyed by the insatiable need for newer, flashier stuff, even though in actuality we know Earth was destroyed by something far more sinister and impossible to predict.

segments.text: 2 minutes, 10 seconds Ironically, the film presents this world of overconsumption in the minimalist style of the silent film era.
segments.rawText: 2:10 2 minutes, 10 seconds Ironically, the film presents this world of overconsumption in the minimalist style of the silent film era.

segments.text: 2 minutes, 16 seconds Rather than dialogue, Wall-E communicates its message using the actions of its title character, whose antics are reminiscent of early stars like Buster Keaton, Charlie Chaplin, and woman stomping on grapes.
